adapter.name: Filesystem Adapter
adapter.description: Sandboxed per-tenant filesystem operations behind the Action Gateway.

supported_actions.name: write_file
supported_actions.params_scope: relative path inside tenant sandbox plus bounded contents or bytes

supported_actions.name: list_dir
supported_actions.params_scope: relative directory path inside tenant sandbox

trace_behavior.evidence: Trace-safe sandbox-relative path intent, resolved tenant sandbox output, byte counts, verifier reasons, and postcondition references. Do not trace secrets or unbounded file contents.

replay_behavior.notes: Replay reconstructs filesystem outcomes from trace/state and does not read, list, stat, or write files.

scopes.agent_scope: required agent_id quota and permission scope
scopes.data_scope: declared relative file or directory path
scopes.filesystem_scope: base_dir joined with tenant_id; absolute paths and traversal denied

governance_support.approval: not_required_by_default; policy may require approval for writes or sensitive paths

limitations: Local-safe is limited to declared tenant sandboxes and does not authorize arbitrary host filesystem access.
No marketplace, legal certification, production support, or compliance claim.
No network-safe, governance-aware, or device-safe claim is made by this manifest.
